sdk_evidence.finding: SDK wrapper default y is gated on DEBUG or core dump/GDB. PERF without those gates drops wrapper.
Actual installed parser ORs node dependencies and appends defaults. Help at3782 states this; multiple definitions generate informational notice, not a conflicting second symbol.
Task wrapper calls task, logs return, then aborts. Only CONFIG_FREERTOS_TASK_FUNCTION_WRAPPER guards it; no DEBUG code dependency. Existing documented overhead16bytes per task call stack.
Initial frame pc points to wrapper; call0 and windowed ABI arguments are set accordingly. This is the real mechanism, not an application-level macro alias.
Wrapper placement also uses the same configuration symbol, not DEBUG.

accepted_design.definition:
config FREERTOS_TASK_FUNCTION_WRAPPER
    bool
    depends on IDF_TARGET_ESP32S3 && COMPILER_OPTIMIZATION_PERF
    default y
accepted_design.semantic_scope: Adds exactly S3+PERF to the original allowed dependency. No prompt/select, GDB or core dump enable, SDK edit, abort replacement or watchdog modification. Conditional depends on is essential; do not use an unconstrained second definition.
accepted_design.guard_scope: S3 && PERF && !WRAPPER -> compile error. Other targets and other optimization modes retain previous SDK semantics.
accepted_design.future_sdk_limit: Guard catches a missing/false generated configuration flag, not a future SDK implementation that stops honoring that flag. The test requires actual SDK symbol and source hashes, and final ELF inspection remains necessary.

required_parent_final_verification: Generated sdkconfig.h contains CONFIG_FREERTOS_TASK_FUNCTION_WRAPPER=1 and PERF=1; protection scope diff retains assertions, stack checks, watchdog and heap poisoning without enabling GDB/core dump.
Actual Xtensa port.c compile command uses-O2 and real generated configuration.

Final ELF nm/objdump: vPortTaskWrapper (possibly optimized suffix) exists, wrapper body still calls user task and reaches log/abort on return, and initial-frame construction references its actual address. At-O2 stack-frame helper may inline into pxPortInitialiseStack; do not require an unoptimized helper symbol name.
Review the existing panic/restart wrapper integration as part of the actual candidate build; host preprocessing is not target execution or HIL.
